Client Case Studies & Testimonials

Enterprise Engineering in Practice

Resolved p99 latency spikes ahead of our BaFin cross-border audit

We were seeing 380ms p99 latency across our SEPA instant payment processing pipeline during peak morning market hours. Most consultancies we interviewed suggested a total rewrite of our orchestration layer, which would have frozen our product roadmap for nine months. The SRIM Works distributed systems team embedded with our platform squad in Stockholm within two weeks. Instead of a high-risk rewrite, they isolated our Kafka event partitioning bottlenecks and refactored our Redis caching tier. We achieved sub-45ms p99 latency before our Q3 compliance audit without a single minute of transaction downtime.

Henrik Lindqvist

VP of Platform Engineering — ValoPay Nordic AB (Stockholm · €185M ARR)

Delivered our unified institutional wealth portal 6 weeks ahead of deadline

Merging two legacy asset management interfaces into a single institutional dashboard was becoming a serious UX bottleneck for our fixed-income analysts in Paris. SRIM Works didn't just write frontend code; their senior developers actually understood bond yield curves and portfolio rebalancing workflows. They built a modular React design system with strict type safety that cut our analyst onboarding time by nearly 40%. Their automated integration test suite gave us immense peace of mind—zero regressions in production since launch.

Mathilde Delacroix

Chief Product Officer — Nexura Capital SAS (Paris · €140M AUM)
